scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @pr/api" "npm run dev -w @pr/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @pr/api && npm run typecheck -w @pr/web
